enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping with air conditioner on due to heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on air conditioner. Set temperature. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to other side. Adjust blanket. Sleep. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Sleep. Wake up briefly. Check phone. Put phone down. Sleep. Wake up. Turn off air conditioner. Sit up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl and spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Pick up bowl. Rinse bowl. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Put phone away. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to locker room. Change into work clothes. Walk to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at work area. Check schedule. Wash hands. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Record data. Administer medication. Update chart. Walk to next patient. Repeat. Take break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend meeting. Update records. Use computer. End shift. Walk to locker room. Change into street clothes.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Put phone away. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to home. Enter home. Take off shoes. Hang up coat. Walk to living room.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Pick up plate. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Drink water. Put glass down. Watch TV.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wash body and hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Dry with towel. Put on clothes. Turn off light.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Log in. Check email. Type document. Save. Close laptop. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Pick up book. Read. Put book down. Get snack. Return. Sit down. Turn on TV. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Pick up phone. Plug in charger. Connect phone. Put phone on nightstand. Turn on air conditioner. Set temperature. Pull back blanket. Lie down on bed. Pick up book. Read. Put book down. Turn off light. Close eyes. Sleep.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to other side. Adjust blanket. Sleep.
